frequency_question: What proportion of major federal franchise restriction bills pass the Senate under similar partisan polarization conditions?
membership_rule: Includes major standalone federal voting restriction or documentation bills that reached chamber floor consideration; excludes minor technical amendments and omnibus budget reconciliation riders.

cases.name: National Voter Registration Act Amendments (Motor Voter restriction attempts)
Help America Vote Act (HAVA) ID amendment debates
Federal Election Integrity Act (standalone proof-of-citizenship push)
For the People Act / Freedom to Vote Act counter-efforts (restrictive provisions)

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named; believed roughly 5 in total meeting strict criteria
known_gaps: Excludes committee-only stalls that never reached formal floor posture.
skeleton: Four major legislative episodes spanning three decades of high polarization where strict federal voting prerequisites were attempted without bipartisan consensus.
validity_reason: Remains valid until the next major shift in Senate filibuster rules or partisan alignment.
